verdict_text: DM recommendation A: fund at most one bounded original-node use/design decision and its complete intake, with zero numerical exposure. Strongest alternative U is no additional MGTAP allocation this round, retain DENSE and ACTIVE/MEDIUM. PARK is a Portfolio-only lifecycle alternative.
